title: Address code review feedback - toast cap, filter callbacks, aria-live, analytics label, splash URL
steps: Add max 5 concurrent toasts to ToastProvider.tsx, evicting oldest when exceeded
Remove useCallback wrappers in MatchFilters.tsx since they provide no benefit with unstable deps
Add aria-live='polite' to filter results count paragraph in MatchFilters.tsx
Update AnalyticsSection.tsx heading to clarify it shows all matches
Extract champion key from championIcon URL for splash art in MatchCard.tsx
acceptance_criteria: ToastProvider caps toasts at 5, evicting oldest
MatchFilters handlers are simple inline functions without useCallback
Analytics section heading indicates it covers all matches
Splash art URL is derived from championIcon URL, not match.champion
